'''Hrosus''', better known as '''Hrosus the Swift''', was an individual who became famous as a [[Varactyl/Legends|varactyl]]-rider. In a head-to-head race that earned him great fame, Hrosus was even able to beat a [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] bike while riding his mount.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hrosus was mentioned in the Codex entry for varactyls in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Codex" />
